rationale: Nearest distance from multiple sources through passable four-neighbor cells differs from single-source route multiplicity and unrestricted Manhattan distance. Walls, unreachable cells, absent sources and competing sources are explicit; independent per-target search and max-layout certificates detect first-source-only and wall-ignoring faults.
limitations: Coverage reports mark current sources not_tracked; conclusions use direct source inspection.
Native receipt matching is read-only reconciliation and native acceptance remains a separate gate.
Global243 map synthesis and exhaustive learner histories remain separate; technical rights review is not human legal approval.
